assertions.name: borromean_pole_leading_coefficient_is_minus_one
assertions.source: Route A: tr_M(β_Bor, q)·q⁴ from the Lean-proved closed form evaluated at q = 1e-15 in mpmath at 50 dps. Route B: sympy's exact limit of q^order·tr_M as q → 0 after clearing denominators in ℚ(q). The retracted attribution needed -1/12 here.

assertions.name: borromean_pole_order_is_four
assertions.source: Route A: the q-valuation of numerator and denominator of cancel(together(tr_M)) — deg-lowest monomial exponents, exact integer arithmetic in sympy. Route B: the pole order commit 6766b40b9 states for β_Bor (4, versus the 10 the 2026-05-04 Ocneanu audit reported for the proton T_w).

assertions.name: k_required_matches_integer_twelve_within_verdict_band
assertions.source: Route A: k = (2·m_μ·F_Bor − m_p)/m_e at 50 dps from CODATA masses and F_Bor = |tr_M(β_Bor)|·[3]_q!/q³. Route B: the integer 12 in m_p = 2·m_μ·F_Bor − 12·m_e (audit 2026-05-25). Tolerance 0.01 is the threshold the Step-4 verdict branches on.

assertions.name: local_electron_mass_literal_matches_codata_registry
assertions.source: Route A: the m_e literal hand-typed in this module and used to divide out k. Route B: codata_constants.M_E_MEV. k scales as 1/m_e, so a drift of 1e-5 relative here moves k by more than the 0.01 band assertion (3) allows.

description: Re-examines commit 6766b40b9's correction of the Ocneanu −1/12 attribution for the proton-mass-identity '12'. Confirms the Borromean pole-order claim (pole 4, leading -1) but finds the empirical k = 12.0xx is tighter than the audit's 'empirical integer near-match' phrasing suggests, deserving deeper categorical investigation. Several natural candidates (4·3 edge cells, Σd_λ²·2, 3!·[2]_q-at-1) all give 12 EXACTLY.

data.verdict: AUDIT VERDICT STANDS but with NUANCE: the empirical k ≈ 12 is extraordinarily close to integer 12 (~10⁻⁴ relative). The correction commit was right that the Borromean's pole structure doesn't give -1/12 — but the integer 12 itself is so tight (10⁻⁴) that it deserves a NEW structural explanation, not just 'empirical near-match.' Several natural candidates (4·3 = #edge cells × #strands; Σd_λ²·2 = 6·2; 3!·[2]_q at q=1 = 12) hit exactly 12 — deserves categorical investigation.
